title: A reader writes: remaining with quiet, respectful, disbelief
excerpt: A reader writes … “ A New Kind of Christianity” is an outstanding contribution to a significant silent spiritual segment of our population. Some of us continue in our Churches for many reasons with a quiet, repectful, disbelief of the dogma espoused.
body:
A reader writes …

 “ A New Kind of Christianity” is an outstanding contribution to a significant silent spiritual segment of our population. Some of us continue in our Churches for many reasons with a quiet, repectful, disbelief of the dogma espoused.
